gastronomy.name: Sushi
gastronomy.blurb: Bite-sized rice and fish rolls, sometimes shaped like little rolls or cute animals.

gastronomy.name: Ramen
gastronomy.blurb: A steamy bowl of noodles in warm broth, perfect for a cool Tokyo evening.

gastronomy.name: Mochi
gastronomy.blurb: A soft, chewy rice cake, sometimes filled with sweet bean paste or ice cream.

gastronomy.name: Takoyaki
gastronomy.blurb: Round, golden dough balls cooked on a special pan, a favorite street-fair snack.

gastronomy.name: Taiyaki
gastronomy.blurb: A fish-shaped waffle cake, warm and filled with sweet custard or red bean.

sites.name: Tokyo Tower
sites.blurb: A tall red-and-white tower that lights up the skyline at night.

sites.name: Senso-ji Temple
sites.blurb: An old lantern-lit temple with a giant paper lantern at the gate.

sites.name: Shibuya Crossing
sites.blurb: A giant crosswalk where streams of people cross from every direction.

gastronomy.name: Croissant
gastronomy.blurb: A flaky, buttery pastry, warm and golden from the bakery oven.

gastronomy.name: Baguette
gastronomy.blurb: A long, crusty loaf of bread baked fresh every morning.

gastronomy.name: Macaron
gastronomy.blurb: A tiny, colorful sandwich cookie with a sweet filling in the middle.

sites.name: Eiffel Tower
sites.blurb: An iron tower so tall it sparkles with lights every evening.

sites.name: The Louvre
sites.blurb: A giant museum shaped like a glass pyramid, full of famous art.

madlib.template: In Paris, I climbed a {0} tower and looked out over a {1} city. For a snack I ate a {2} pastry that smelled like {3}.

gastronomy.name: Poke
gastronomy.blurb: Cubes of fresh fish tossed with rice and a tasty sauce.

gastronomy.name: Shave ice
gastronomy.blurb: A mountain of finely shaved ice soaked in bright, fruity syrups.

gastronomy.name: Fish and chips
gastronomy.blurb: Crispy battered fish with a big pile of golden fries, usually wrapped in paper.

gastronomy.name: Scone
gastronomy.blurb: A soft, crumbly bake served with jam and cream for afternoon tea.

sites.name: Big Ben
sites.blurb: A famous clock tower that chimes loudly on the hour.

sites.name: The Thames
sites.blurb: A wide river that winds right through the middle of the city.
